doc.intent_adaptive.overview: Intent adaptive pipeline: classify text into IntentFamily + primary_type, then route to preset templates, clarification, or the existing Planner/workflow path. Step 1 adds contracts only (`cortex/intent_adaptive/models.py`). SSOT: `docs/intent_adaptive_pipeline.md`.
doc.intent_adaptive.step1_models: Step 1 (intent adaptive): Pydantic models `IntentFamily`, `IntentType` wire ids, `IntentClassificationResult` (confidence, snake_case slots, route template|dynamic|clarify, reason_codes). No EventBus wiring yet; tests: `tests/test_intent_adaptive_models.py`.
doc.intent_adaptive.step2_template_regis: Step 2 (intent adaptive): `TemplateRegistry` + `IntentTemplateHandler` protocol (`match_score`, `execute`), `TemplateExecutionContext` ports (`send_reply`, `router_call_llm`, `web_search`), `TemplateOutcome`, `NoOpTemplateHandler`. Not wired into `DecisionProcessor` yet; tests: `tests/test_intent_adaptive_registry.py`.
doc.intent_adaptive.rule_tier: Step 3 (Phase 1): `rule_classify_after_router` in `cortex/intent_adaptive/rule_classifier.py` — keyword/regex heuristics only when `SemanticIntentRouter.route_task` returns `COMPLEX_TASK`; bounded confidence (`RULE_CONFIDENCE_MAX`); skips `/report…` and never overrides `SYSTEM_ACTION` / `DIRECT_ANSWER`. Not wired into `DecisionProcessor` yet; tests: `tests/test_intent_adaptive_rule_classifier.py`.
doc.intent_adaptive.step4_llm_classifier: Step 4: optional `maybe_llm_classify_after_rule` / `maybe_llm_classify_with_settings` in `cortex/intent_adaptive/llm_classifier.py` — strict JSON via `call_llm` when `ADAMI_INTENT_LLM_CLASSIFIER_ENABLED=true` and the rule tier is weak/absent on `COMPLEX_TASK`. Config: `ADAMI_INTENT_CLASSIFIER_MIN_CONFIDENCE`, `ADAMI_INTENT_CLASSIFIER_TIMEOUT_SEC`. Defaults keep Step-3-only behaviour (`ENABLED=false`). Tests: `tests/test_intent_adaptive_llm_classifier.py`.
doc.intent_adaptive.step41_merge: Step 4.1: `apply_family_merge_policy` in `merge_policies.py` — multi-label `families` JSON merges into one primary: **system** always wins; **action** needs `ADAMI_INTENT_ACTION_PERMISSION_GRANTED` or it is demoted to `clarify` / `unknown`. `IntentClassificationResult.secondary_types` holds extra type wire ids. User copy: `intent.clarify.prompt`. Tests: `tests/test_intent_adaptive_merge_policies.py`.
doc.intent_adaptive.step5_decision_wirin: Step 5 (intent adaptive): `DecisionProcessor._maybe_route_intent_adaptive` runs before `TaskPlanner.plan_and_execute` on `COMPLEX_TASK` when `ADAMI_INTENT_ADAPTIVE_PIPELINE_ENABLED=true` (default **false**): `rule_classify_after_router` → optional `maybe_llm_classify_with_settings` → `intent_template_registry.resolve` → template `_send_reply` when confidence ≥ `ADAMI_INTENT_CLASSIFIER_MIN_CONFIDENCE` and `TemplateOutcome.handoff_to_dynamic` is false; `route=clarify` sends `intent.clarify.prompt`; else Planner. Registry is built in `ComponentInitializer` (`intent_template_registry`). Optional notice: `intent.adaptive.user.fallback_to_planner` + `ADAMI_INTENT_ADAPTIVE_FALLBACK_NOTICE`. Tests: `tests/test_decision_processor_intent_adaptive_smoke.py`.
doc.intent_adaptive.step6_templates: Step 6 (intent adaptive): built-in preset templates under `cortex/intent_adaptive/templates/` (`RetrievalWeatherTemplateHandler`, `RetrievalCryptoTemplateHandler`). `bootstrap_templates.register_builtin_intent_templates` registers `retrieval.weather` and `retrieval.crypto` on kernel init after the noop slot. Handlers fill slots from `TemplateExecutionContext.classification`, call `ToolboxManager.web.search` when wired, then optional `router_call_llm` Markdown fallback — **no subprocess** in template code. User help: `intent.help.body`, `intent.help.supported_types`. Tests: `tests/test_intent_adaptive_step6_e2e_templates.py`.
doc.intent_adaptive.step51_observability: Step 5.1 (intent adaptive observability): when a classification exists, the active `DecisionProcessor.process` span receives attributes `intent.family`, `intent.type`, `intent.confidence`, and `intent.route` (see `cortex/intent_adaptive/telemetry.py`). DEBUG logs use the prefix `[intent_adaptive]` (grep kernel or pytest CLI output). Span writes are best-effort and noop-safe when the tracer stub has no `set_attribute`.
doc.intent_adaptive.planner_hook: Step 7.1 (intent adaptive → Planner): when `intent_adaptive_meta` is present, `TaskPlanner.plan_and_execute` injects an English one-line summary beginning with **Prior intent guess:** (route, family, type, confidence, and `prior_tier_handoff` / handoff reason) into `planner_prompts.GENERATE_PLAN_PROMPT`, the Anthropic workflow-skill wrapper, and the MCP-Agent pilot objective preamble. Step 7 DEBUG JSON logging is unchanged. Tests: `tests/test_planner_intent_adaptive_meta_step71.py`.
doc.operator.intent_adaptive_grep: Ops: set log level DEBUG for logger `AdamI-DecisionProcessor`, then grep for `[intent_adaptive]` to audit tiered intent decisions (family, type, confidence, route in the same log line).

demo.fallback.what-adami-can-do.body: Adami is a kernel that routes tasks, plans multi-step work, and talks over CLI or messengers. This page is a guided demo only: it cannot run shell commands, send messages, or read your production notes.
demo.fallback.goal-planning.title: Prepared plan outline
demo.fallback.goal-planning.body:
1) Clarify the outcome.
2) List constraints.
3) Order 3–5 steps.
4) Mark what a human must approve.
This outline is a canned example — the demo did not execute anything.
demo.fallback.analyze-problem.title: Prepared analysis
demo.fallback.analyze-problem.body: Restate the problem, name one assumption, and propose a smallest next check. This is a prepared example, not a live investigation.
demo.fallback.memory-mechanism.title: Prepared memory note
